title: Shift descent and exactness on finite-stage point triangles
statement: Fix D and a prime l different from its characteristic and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l as in [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. The specified common-stage Omega fibre admits a coherent integer-shift comparison. For every finite coefficient stage i and every distinguished triangle T at that stage, the image of T under stage inclusion followed by this fibre is distinguished in the precise predicate [def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category]. This statement only treats stage images, not arbitrary triangles together with their descent isomorphisms.

source.place: Shift descent and exactness on finite-stage point triangles; extracted from the point-fibre argument; lean/Sheaf/Paper/PointQbarFibreShiftDescent.lean, pointQbarFibre_shift_descent

proof.text: Use the exact rational fibre shift comparison at every finite coefficient field and the exact field tensor comparison. The completion/scalar comparison commutes with all shifts, as does the normalized sections/tensor comparison. Their composites and inverses therefore show that pointStageFibreScalarIso commutes with shifts, including the rationalization and size-descent normalizations. Conjugation by the source and target isoToStage maps descends these comparisons to the specified common-stage functor. Naturality and the identity and three-field coherence equations prove independence of the representative, and the zero and addition laws.

For a distinguished triangle at a finite stage, rational exactness gives a distinguished triangle of small coefficient complexes. The Shrink coefficient equivalence and extension from that finite field to Omega are exact. The tensor-tower and shift comparisons identify its scalar extension with the realized image under the common-stage fibre of the source-stage inclusion. The three vertices are bounded finite-dimensional by definition. This is precisely a witness of pointFdQbarDistinguished. This step does not descend an arbitrary source triangle isomorphism; that is done in the parent proof.

lean.statement:
theorem pointQbarFibre_shift_descent
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω] :
    ∃ c : (pointQbarFibre D l hl Ω).CommShift ℤ,
      ∀ (i : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
        (T : Triangle (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω (Spec (.of D.k)) i)),
        T ∈ distTriang _ → DerivedCategory.pointFdQbarDistinguished l Ω
          ((@Functor.mapTriangle _ _ _ _ _ _ _ c).obj
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion i).mapTriangle.obj T))
